name: bell
description: Rings — the whole bell swings wide from its mount, left first.

name: bell-ringing
description: Rings out loud — the bell whips from its mount and sound draws off both sides.

name: bell-slash
description: Silenced — a token shake dies as the slash strikes through.

name: heart
description: Lub-dub — a quick squeeze, then two beats, the second softer.

name: star
description: Catches the light — stretches its points, settles, then glimmers once more.

name: trash
description: Opens — the lid lifts clear of the bin, which absorbs it on the way down.

name: trash-simple
description: Lifts — the lid and its handle hop straight off the bin and drop back.

name: gear
description: Winds up, then turns a tooth counter-clockwise and eases in.

name: gear-six
description: Turns a tooth clockwise, overshoots, and clicks into place.

name: house
description: Hops once — a welcoming little bounce.

name: magnifying-glass
description: Sweeps a slow arc, the way you search a page.

name: user
description: Draws itself — the head sketches in first, the shoulders follow.

name: users
description: Joins in — the second figure leans in behind the first and settles.

name: plus
description: Stamps — each stroke overshoots long, pinches short, and settles.

name: minus
description: Pinches to the centre, then snaps back to full width.

name: x
description: Struck out — two strokes cross in turn, and the pair lands with a snap.

name: check
description: Stamps in — the check draws on while scaling up to size.

name: check-circle
description: Confirms — the check rewrites itself and the ring nods.

name: x-circle
description: Rejects — the cross twists in and pops while the ring pulses around it.

name: eye
description: Blinks — the lid closes as the pupil contracts behind it.

name: eye-slash
description: Hidden — the slash draws itself across the eye.

name: lock
description: Clicks shut — the shackle presses in and the body shudders tight.

name: lock-open
description: Springs — the shackle flicks wider while the whole lock jolts.

name: key
description: Turns in the lock — deep, a small rebound, then lets go.

name: shield-check
description: Re-verifies — the shield braces while the check pops in and redraws.

name: bookmark-simple
description: Saved — stretches down, squashes, and settles into place.

name: tag
description: Swings — nudged, the tag rocks on its eyelet and settles.

name: pencil-simple
description: Writes — the nib travels a quick scribble while the shaft tilts.

name: note-pencil
description: Edits — the pencil scribbles a quick stroke against the note.

name: copy
description: Duplicates — the sheets spring apart, then snap back into a stack.

name: clipboard
description: Snaps — the clip pops up and claps back down; the board takes the hit.

name: link
description: Tugs — the two halves pull apart, then snap back past centre.

name: dots-three
description: Hops — each dot pops up in turn, left to right.

name: list
description: Scans — each row's right edge sweeps in and snaps back, top to bottom.

name: sliders
description: Adjusts — the knobs take turns sliding along their tracks.

name: funnel
description: Squeezes — pinches in and pushes down, forcing everything through.

name: arrow-right
description: Recoils — the arrow draws back, then springs home.

name: arrow-left
description: Recoils — shaft retracting — then strikes back to the left.

name: arrow-up
description: Crouches — the arrow dips down, then springs back up.

name: arrow-down
description: Recoils upward — shaft retracting — then strikes back down.

name: arrow-clockwise
description: Refreshes — one clockwise turn, away fast and easing home.

name: arrow-counter-clockwise
description: Undoes — one turn back, away fast and easing home.

name: caret-down
description: Nudges downward, the way it points.

name: caret-right
description: Nudges forward, the way it points.

name: arrow-square-out
description: Slips out — the arrow drifts toward the corner and recedes.

name: sign-out
description: Leaves — the arrow winds up and lunges out, the door recoiling behind it.

name: sign-in
description: Enters — the arrow lunges in through the door, which takes the bump.

name: map-pin
description: Hops off the map and stamps back down — the dot draws in as it lands.

name: compass
description: Finds north — the needle whips a full turn, overshoots, and settles.

name: globe
description: Draws itself — the rim first, then the meridian and parallels trace on.

name: flag
description: Gusts — the cloth lifts from the pole, billows, and settles to rest.

name: anchor
description: Sways from its ring, the way a moored anchor rides the swell.

name: envelope
description: Opens — the flap swings up, then snaps shut with a soft bounce.

name: envelope-open
description: The letter inside pushes up — the pocket fold lifts, then settles shut.

name: paper-plane-tilt
description: Sends — flies out of frame and a fresh one arrives.

name: chat-circle
description: Perks up — the bubble swells and shakes on its tail.

name: chat-teardrop-dots
description: Typing — the dots blink out and back, left to right.

name: phone
description: Rings — the handset rattles in decaying swings and settles home.

name: phone-call
description: Connects — the handset rocks while the signal waves blink out and pop back, inner first.

name: at
description: Writes itself — the centre loops first, then the spiral sweeps around.

name: share-network
description: Broadcasts — the hub pulses, the wires carry the signal, the nodes pop as it lands.

name: hand-waving
description: Waves hello, pivoting at the wrist.

name: megaphone
description: Shouts — rears up on its grip, then settles.

name: play
description: Starts — the triangle coils back with a tilt, then springs forward.

name: pause
description: Holds — the bars dip in turn, left then right, and spring back.

name: stop
description: Presses in — the square dips like a struck button, then settles.

name: skip-forward
description: Skips ahead — the triangle lunges at the end bar and knocks it.

name: skip-back
description: Skips back — the triangle lunges at the start bar and knocks it.

name: shuffle
description: Weaves — both tracks redraw through the crossing and the heads snap outward.

name: repeat
description: Loops — the cycle turns once around and springs into place.

name: music-note
description: Plays — the note sways to the beat while its head pulses.

name: headphones
description: Thumps — the band flexes down onto the ears and springs back, twice.

name: speaker-high
description: Sounds — the cone pulses and the waves radiate out from it.

name: speaker-x
description: Muted — the cross draws itself in, stroke after stroke.

name: microphone
description: Sound check — the capsule bobs one-two in its cradle.

name: microphone-slash
description: Muted — the slash draws itself across the capsule.

name: camera
description: Pulls focus — the lens breathes, then the body snaps the shot.

name: image
description: Lifts in hand — the sun and hills shift with shallow parallax.

name: video-camera
description: Rolls — the body breathes while the lens draws back and returns.

name: folder
description: Picked up — lifts with a small lean, then settles back with weight.

name: folder-open
description: Wobbles — the whole folder rocks on its base and settles.

name: file
description: Hops — the page lifts with a small tilt while the corner fold flares.

name: file-text
description: Rewrites — the file perks up as its lines erase and retype.

name: files
description: Fans apart — the sheets slide diagonally away from each other and spring back.

name: archive
description: Opens — the lid pops clear, hangs a beat, then drops shut.

name: printer
description: Prints — the paper feeds through the body and the status light blinks.

name: download-simple
description: Delivers — the arrow springs down and back while the tray dips to take it.

name: upload-simple
description: Sends — the arrow springs up and back while the tray dips to launch it.

name: cloud-arrow-up
description: Uploads — the arrow dips, surges up, and the cloud lifts buoyantly with it.

name: floppy-disk
description: Saves — the disk presses in with a click while label and door rewrite.

name: shopping-cart
description: Hops — added to the cart, so it bounces four times and lands on its wheels.

name: shopping-bag
description: Picked up — the handle lifts over the top edge as the bag rocks once and settles.

name: credit-card
description: Swipes — the whole card slides through and the digits catch up.

name: currency-dollar
description: Draws itself — the curve sweeps through, then the bar strikes down.

name: wallet
description: Hefts — the whole wallet lifts, tips back, and drops into place.

name: gift
description: What's inside? — the box rocks from its base while the bows flutter.

name: package
description: Draws itself — the box outlines first, then its seams.

name: truck
description: Jounces — the body bobs on its springs while the wheels stay planted.

name: receipt
description: Itemises — the lines ink themselves in, top to bottom.

name: storefront
description: Ripples — the awning scallops flap in turn, left to right.

name: sun
description: Lights up — the core pops and the rays flare one by one, clockwise.

name: moon
description: Rocks side to side, a crescent settling into the night.

name: cloud
description: Swells — a soft roll lifts the cloud and sets it back down.

name: lightning
description: Strikes — the bolt draws itself on, strike-quick.

name: fire
description: Ignites — the flame draws itself on, the inner tongue catching last.

name: drop
description: Draws itself — the outline traces on, then the sheen follows.

name: leaf
description: Drifts — tilting and travelling at once, the way a leaf falls.

name: tree
description: Sways — the whole tree leans through a gust and settles on its roots.

name: snowflake
description: Shivers — the whole flake flicks side to side and settles.

name: wind
description: Blows through — each stream draws itself on, one gust behind the last.

name: umbrella
description: Takes the weather — it rocks under the shaft while the canopy absorbs the hit.

name: rainbow
description: Appears — the bands draw on, inner arc first.

name: cow
description: Cocks its head — a slow tilt, and a blink halfway through.

name: device-mobile
description: Buzzes — the handset rattles, then settles.

name: laptop
description: Nods — the lid dips shut a touch, then springs back open.

name: desktop
description: Wakes — the screen lights and the stand takes the weight.

name: keyboard
description: Types — key, key, spacebar, each blinking as it's struck.

name: mouse
description: Clicks — the whole mouse presses down and springs back, wheel first.

name: game-controller
description: Rumbles — a quick vibration buzzes through the pad and dies out.

name: battery-full
description: Recharges — the bars blank out, then refill from the left.

name: battery-charging
description: Charging — the bolt pulses twice as the current lands.

name: wifi-high
description: Reconnects — the signal drops out and rebuilds outward from the dot.

name: bluetooth
description: Reconnects — the whole glyph redraws itself like a signal coming back.

name: power
description: Presses — the whole switch dips in and pops back.

name: plug
description: Connects — the plug snaps home, then current flickers through the prongs.

name: hard-drive
description: Reads — the activity light pops and blinks twice.

name: code
description: Recompiles — the slash slips off down-left and a fresh one drops in from above.

name: terminal-window
description: Types — the prompt pops and the line runs out after it.

name: git-branch
description: Draws itself — the new node pops in, the branch traces on, the tip lands.

name: bug
description: Skitters — mismatched legs twitch while the body shifts its weight.

name: database
description: Scans — a pulse sweeps the platters, top to bottom.

name: cpu
description: Ticks — every pin stretches with the clock, twice.

name: cube
description: Draws itself — the outline first, then the folded inner edges.

name: wrench
description: Ratchets — cranks the bolt in its jaws, then springs back.

name: hammer
description: Strikes — a slow windup, then the head snaps down and recoils.

name: magic-wand
description: Flicks — the wand snaps a small arc and the stars twinkle in turn.

name: rocket
description: Test-fires — hops off the pad, fins trailing, exhaust flaring beneath.

name: lightbulb
description: An idea — the glass flexes as the shine redraws.

name: brain
description: Thinks — one deep breath while the folds retract and redraw.

name: sparkle
description: Lifts — the big sparkle bobs while the small stars blink in turn.

name: warning
description: Alerts — the triangle takes the knock and the exclamation snaps back up.

name: warning-circle
description: Alerts — the ring squashes and the exclamation bounces back into place.

name: info
description: The "i" bobs — the dot hops while the stem squashes and the ring breathes.

name: question
description: Wonders — the mark waggles side to side, dot in tow.

name: thumbs-up
description: Approves — the whole hand lifts and tips back, with a little pop.

name: thumbs-down
description: Rejects — the whole hand presses down and tips, with a little pop.

name: smiley
description: Beams — the face pops and tilts, the eyes widen and the grin deepens.

name: spinner
description: Spins — one full turn of the wheel, winding up and easing off.

name: circle-notch
description: Spins — one full turn, up to speed and easing home.

name: hourglass
description: Flips over with a springy half-turn — the sand starts again.

name: clock
description: Fast-forwards — the hands whip one brisk full turn.

name: timer
description: Starts — the crown presses down and the hand sweeps a full turn.

name: alarm
description: Rattles — the whole clock rocks gently side to side while the bells flick.

name: confetti
description: Pops — the cone recoils and the confetti kicks outward.

name: crown
description: Bows — one restrained dip and lift while the jewels flash in turn.

name: trophy
description: Hoisted — the whole trophy is raised and set back down with weight.

name: target
description: Hits — the arrow draws back, lands, and the rings ring outward from the centre.

name: heartbeat
description: The pulse sweeps through first, then the heart draws in and beats.

name: chart-line
description: Replots — the trend line fades in as it draws across the axes.

name: chart-bar
description: Redraws — the columns wipe away and rise again in turn.

name: chart-pie-slice
description: Breaks out — the slice springs free, hangs a beat, and rejoins.

name: trend-up
description: Redraws — the line retraces its climb while the frame lifts with it.

name: trend-down
description: Redraws — the line retraces its fall while the frame dips with it.
